# Assessment Overview

This overview links to the supplementary assessment documents generated for ContosoUniversity.

- [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) — High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) — Declared external dependencies grouped by functional category and compatibility risks.
- [API and Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) — MVC endpoints, JSON notification contracts, and communication patterns.
- [Data Architecture and Persistence Layer](data-architecture.md) — Database configuration, entity model, persistence boundaries, and data sensitivity.
- [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, runtime settings, profiles, secrets posture, and framework versions.
- [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) — Core school administration workflows, business rules, and decision logic.
